newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP says has no date for bond issue.
newsitem.headline: BNP says has no date for bond issue.

text.p: French bank Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP), which suspended plans to launch a subordinated bond issue on the U.S. market on Thursday, said it did not know when the issue would be made.

The bank said in a statement it suspended the launch because of a newspaper article which said BNP held the edge over rival bank Societe Generale to buy French bank CIC which is being privatised by the government.
"It was an entirely standard bond issue but we thought for reasons of transparency we should delay the issue," a spokeswoman said.
Business daily Les Echos reported on Thursday morning that BNP seemed better placed than Societe Generale to acquire CIC, which is part of state-owned insurer GAN.
The newspaper said France's Privatisation Committee could make its decision known later on Thursday about the admissibility of the offers by Societe Generale and BNP.
The spokeswoman would not comment on the newspaper report.
